content.text: 13. REMOVE OUTPUT SHAFT REAR BEARING AND FIFTH GEAR

content.description: Illustration showing the removal of output shaft rear bearing and fifth gear using SST tool

items: (a) Using two screwdrivers and a hammer, tap out the snap ring.
(b) Using SST, remove the rear bearing and 5th gear.

content.description: Illustration showing the removal of reverse gear using SST tool

items: (a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.
(b) Using SST, remove the reverse gear.

content.description: Illustration showing the removal of center bearing retainer using torx socket wrench

items: (a) Using a torx socket wrench, unscrew the torx screws and remove the retainer.
(b) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

content.text: 16. REMOVE OUTPUT SHAFT AND COUNTER GEAR AS A UNIT FROM INTERMEDIATE PLATE

content.description: Illustration showing the removal of output shaft and counter gear as a unit from intermediate plate

items: (a) Remove the output shaft, input shaft and counter gear as a unit from the intermediate plate by pulling on the counter gear and tapping on the intermediate plate with a plastic hammer.
(b) Remove the input shaft from output shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of gear thrust clearance using a feeler gauge

content.text: Using a feeler gauge, measure the thrust clearance of each gear.
